items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1978-04-20
items.q: I left to go with Sheryl and Lee on the road.

ctx.x: Booker, Washington. Yeah. And then I went to Coyne for a few months. I quit Booker T to go out and play a bit. Reached the Guild Complex and thought I'd go back to school for ten minutes. I did, pretending. That being Coyne, at that time I left to go with Sheryl and Lee on the road. But I considered Booker T because I spent most of the time there. I spent an hour there. Meaning about three years, almost three years.
Were there any other musicians there with you? Any other musicians at Booker T with you?
